checks.criterion: PWA install prompt works intelligently
checks.name: pwa-install-prompt-dismiss-persists
checks.evidence: At 390px on /, install-prompt appeared within 25s with Install DigiCon CTA; tapping Install (no native beforeinstallprompt available in this Chromium) revealed install-prompt-steps; tapping Maybe Later hid the prompt and set localStorage digicon.install.dismissedAt; after reload the prompt stayed hidden

checks.criterion: PWA is installable: manifest and official icon set are served
checks.name: pwa-manifest-and-icons-served
checks.evidence: GET /manifest.webmanifest -> 200 display=standalone, name contains DigiCon, icons include 192/512/maskable-512; /icon-192.png /icon-512.png /icon-maskable-512.png /apple-touch-icon.png /favicon.webp /sw.js all -> 200 with correct content-types; index.html has link[rel=manifest]=/manifest.webmanifest, link[rel=apple-touch-icon]=/apple-touch-icon.png, meta[name=theme-color] set

checks.criterion: Official circular DigiCon icon is used as the brand mark
checks.name: digicon-brand-logo-mark
checks.evidence: On /pricing, digicon-logo-link (aria-label=DigiCon home) contains digicon-mark img with src=/icon-192.png and alt=""; clicking the link navigates to / and shows landing-hero-heading

checks.criterion: Landing page integrates the supplied brand imagery full-width with SEO alt text
checks.name: landing-brand-imagery-and-alt-text
checks.evidence: At 390px, scrolled through landing-banner-hero + 4 story images (share/connect/remember/grow): all had naturalWidth>0, unique alt text >40 chars each, rendered aspect ratio within 15% of natural (uncropped), and all below-the-fold images had loading=lazy

checks.criterion: Landing narrative covers the DigiCon journey with working CTAs
checks.name: landing-narrative-ctas
checks.evidence: Exactly 1 h1; landing-section-{share,connect,remember,grow} all present; landing-secondary-cta jumps to #how-it-works; landing-pricing-cta -> /pricing; landing-primary-cta and landing-footer-cta (signed out) -> /signup

checks.criterion: Persistent glass bottom navigation on mobile, correct desktop behaviour
checks.name: public-bottom-nav-and-desktop-hidden
checks.evidence: At 390px, public-bottom-navigation has exactly 5 links (Home/Pricing/Use Cases/Blog/Sign in), active item marked via aria-current=page, each link navigates correctly (/,/use-cases,/blog,/login), no horizontal overflow on /,/pricing,/use-cases,/blog,/login; at 1280px public-bottom-navigation is hidden and header nav (public-nav-pricing) is used instead
